notes.title: Amber City&Mr. Pumpkin 2 Bundle
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Thank you for your support for Amber City. 

We know most of our players are puzzle game lovers, so we work with Cotton Game and launch a bundle including Amber City and Mr. Pumpkin 2: Kowloon walled city. 

Mr. Pumpkin 2 is a sequel to Mr. Pumpkin Adventure. It is a point-and-click game set in the Kowloon Walled City. 

From September 1st to September 8th, you can get both games at 10% discount. It's additive to 10% Amber City launch discount. Have fun and enjoy!

notes.title: Amber City is released！
notes.content:
Our game is now available on Steam thanks to your company and support! You can get -10% discount for the game in the first week.

Like Flood of Light, Amber City will bring you well-designed puzzles. What's more in Amber City, we designed dozens of creative mechanics and optimized gameplay experience. We hope both casual and hardcore gamers can enjoy the game in a more convenient way. 

A girl in a white dress wakes up in a ruined city. What happened to her? It's up to you to find out!

We also offer you three different bundles with extra discounts, maybe you could find the best option for you.

We offered 4 bundles this time. Unfortunately, we found that Steam store page can only show a maximum of three bundles. You can find another bundle by searching keyword "Amber City".

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42649624/40c71f8f5bdac33b5e3eb4ab91f37d6488fd1632.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Amber City will launch on September 1st
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Long time no see, we've been improving and optimizing our game since the release of demo, and now I am glad to say that Amber City, along with OST and artbook, will be released on September 1st. You can get 10% discount for the game in the first week.

Meanwhile Flood of Light, our previous title, will be 50% off from September 1st. You can even get another -10% discount if you buy the bundle! Check the picture below for more informtion.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42649624/40c71f8f5bdac33b5e3eb4ab91f37d6488fd1632.jpg[/img]

Thanks again for your support！Hope you enjoy the game！

notes.title: Amber City Demo Patch Notes 0.1.6
notes.content:
Hi,
We have made some fixes for the Error report. Hope you can enjoy the game!

[Version 0.1.6]

Bugfix：
1. Fixed data problems caused by different decimal points in different countries that make the character unable to move and to be seen at the first screen.
2. Fixed the incorrect display of English in some cases.

notes.title: Amber City DEMO is now available on Steam
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
Amber City DEMO is now available on Steam!
You can experience part of levels from the first 3 chapters. We hope it will offer you a glimpse into distinctive gameplay mechanics 
and well-designed puzzles of the game. You could also expect a unique background and story.
Come and have a try! And don't forget to wishlist the game!

notes.title: Amber City Demo will be delayed
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We are so sorry that our demo scheduled to be launched today cannot be downloaded 
due to Steam technical error. We are urgently contacting Steam to fix this problem.
We will bring you the latest news as soon as possible.
Thanks for your understanding and support!
